notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix

 Fixed a bug that was triggered when clouds appeared in rainy weather.

notes.title: Sneaking, Clouds, Performance
notes.content:
New

 The character can now sneak.
 In rainy weather, the first cloud shadows can now be seen on the ground from time to time.


New Performance System

 In the settings menu in the game there are now some customization options to adjust the performance.
With more content and simultaneous activity in the game, it was time to improve performance for players with lower-end PCs.
The system is already preset in the game settings and most players shouldn’t need to change anything.


Improvements

 The character now occasionally waves at the player again.
 Stray cats can now be caught with 100% health instead of 50%.
Why would you attack stray cats if all you actually want is to catch them.
 When saving and loading via quicksave, the currently active weather and events are now always taken into account.
 Berry is now back to arriving at her shop punctually at 7 a.m.
 Sandy, as usual, shows up at her shop 30 minutes late again.
 The number of materials required for various weekly quests has been significantly reduced.
 The number of materials required for all weekly Blackboard Quests has been greatly reduced.
 When rainy weather starts, a thunder sound is now played again.
 Character and NPCs upgraded.
 Game Settings UI upgraded.
 First systems implemented for the skill system that will come later.
The druid in the church who sells the spells is still a temporary solution so that players can buy some spells. It is planned that the druid will disappear at some point in the future and be replaced by the skill system.
 Many other minor improvements.


Fixes

 Entities that start as cadavers now remain cadavers even if you approach them.
 The fishing animation should no longer be interrupted by funny animations because the character gets bored.

notes.title: Gamemodes
notes.content:
Gamemodes
The different game modes now have more impact on the game.

 Cozy
Enemy health reduced by 25%.
All damage dealt to the character reduced by 50%.
 Hard
Enemy health increased by 25%.
All damage dealt to the character increased by 50%.
 Hardcore
Enemy health increased by 50%.
All damage dealt to the character increased by 100%.


Improvements

 The damage spectrum of all animals and creatures has been reduced.
So that you can better assess the damage.
 If an aggressive entity following you reaches the maximum tracking range and runs back to its location, a corresponding status message is now displayed.
So that you doesn't wonder why the entity is suddenly running around like a frightened chicken.


Fixes

 Pets are now loaded correctly again when loading a savegame.
 The collider of the pile of wood to the left of the woodworker should now fit again.
 All animals and creatures should now correctly turn in their walking direction again.
 Bears should now correctly return to their original position after retreating from a fight.

notes.title: Food and Affection
notes.content:
New

 Mandrakes can now be found in the forest when it is spring or autumn.
Be sure to pack it right away if you like your ears.
 Lobster and Rosha Lurker can now also be fished in the sea.
 Mina the Cook now also has a Weekly Quest through which you can support her with dishes.
Mina is the cook who is unlocked when you have upgraded the tavern.
 Mina now has 3 reputation quests where you always learn a new special recipe.
30 Elder Fish, 50 Mandrake Soup, 70 Rosha Lurker. These dishes also give different reg buffs.
 Animals that produce something such as female chickens and cows now have a new affection value.
Affection for an animal can be increased simply by stroking it.
Animals with a value of 0 do not lay eggs or give milk.


Improvements

 Publicly accessible inventories such as chests, cupboards etc. now also have their own sorting function.
 The number of lucky charms and wooden figures has been reduced to 1 each.
 The woodworker now chats a bit more about Onyx.
 You can now talk to Charlie about zombies.
 Mixed Area has been renamed Meadows.
 Mana Flower renamed Rosha Flower.


Fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused some zombies to move too fast in the main menu.

notes.title: Player Requests
notes.content:
Saving the game

 The game can now also be saved in bed at any time without ending the day.


Health Bars

 Health bars are now displayed above creatures and animals on damage.
Health bars are disabled in the Hard and Hardcore game modes.


Map Markers

 Several locations are now marked on the map.
Markers can be switched on and off.


Improvements

 The general store now opens earlier at 6 a.m.
 The evening now starts at 7 pm instead of 6 pm.
 Everything that has a retail value can now be sold via the Sellbox until further notice.
 An error message is now displayed in the main menu if the name of the character or the game does not correspond to the specifications.

notes.title: Stray Cats
notes.content:
New

 3 new stray cats added.
They can be caught in the wild and can also be added as pets.
 The family of forest spirits has continued to grow.
 The first versions of small waterfalls were added.


Improvements

 Lights of all torches upgraded.
 All living creatures are now moving more smoothly again.
 The activated pumpkin torch now has a proper fire animation.
 NPCs whose store is currently open will now reliably remain open.
 The own inventory and store window now have their own close button.
 Energy can now be regenerated at the buffet table on Minestra market day.
 The ground now looks a bit more detailed and the grass more lush.
 The two existing cats have been adapted to the new system.
 Some entities now make a sound when you speak to them.
 The Elder Glade now has its own background music.
 Various background music replaced and expanded.
 Shading of all buildable houses improved.
 Appearance of the trash can upgraded.
 Various character animations updated.
 Cats Optics and animations upgraded.
 Forests now look more immersive.
 Various tooltips updated.
 Mounts improved.
 Shadow Essence has been deactivated in the game until further notice.
Golden Goldbars quest now requires Forest Spirits instead of Shadow Essences.
Necromancers no longer drop Shadow Essences.


Fixes

 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused nature to spawn outside of the reachable land area.
 When striking with the machete, the correct weapon animation is now played again.
 Various other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Elder Glade
notes.content:
New region Elder Glade

 The first version of the new clearing is now live.
So that our tree god is in a place that is more worthy of his divinity.
 The Elder Glade can be reached via the cave in the forest.
The scree in front of the passage must be blasted clear beforehand.
 The tree god has moved from the cramped forest cave to his new home.
 Forest spirits are now required for the Tree God's weekly quest.
 A new Elder Fish can be caught in the local waters.
 Tree god visually enhanced.


Discord Rich Presence

 Revised and reactivated.


Improvements

 Bats can now be found in more caves.
 Preparations so that new artifacts can be handed in to the archaeologist and exhibited in the future.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes

 Due to issues, the Discord Rich Presence feature has been temporarily disabled.
 Fixed an issue where lowering the day length would sometimes cause the game to freeze.

notes.title: Maps
notes.content:
Maps

 An initial individual map has been added for each region.
You can now easily switch between the different regional maps using the overview map.
Cave entrances, hidden paths and certain hotspots are not revealed on the maps.
Since the question about maps for the regions has come up several times now.
Further upgrades will be added as needed.


Improvements

 Oven updated to the new system.
Leaves can now be used as firing material again as usual.
 The speed at which fuel is burned has been reduced by 50 % until further notice.
 The current version of Onyx is now always displayed in the Game Settings window.
 The button to send a report in the event of an error message now also closes the window at the same time.
 The selected game mode and the playing time spent in a game is now also displayed in the start menu for the save states.
 Initial updates have been made so that animals will automatically sleep at night later on.
 The time to obtain rock blocks from the quarry has been shortened.
 Coast region updated to improve performance there.
 The fireball now looks more fiery.


Fixes

 An error is no longer triggered when you leave the dwarf cave.
 If you die from a poison in gamemode cozy, the buffs are now updated correctly again.

notes.title: Improvements & Fixes
notes.content:
New

 New hairstyle added.


Improvements

 Berry now always has a watering can on offer.
 The Berry Quest to get the Corer is now only unlocked with a reputation value of 30.
 If you strike in quick succession, a 3-hit combo is now executed.
Damage, knockback and crit chance are increased for each combo hit.
 Pickaxes and axes now also count as weapons and can be used to attack.
 Placed paths and roads can now only be removed with the work hammer.
 Swinging sounds now differ between wooden and metal weapons.
 Reputation window redesigned and prepared for new content.
 Faction reputations deactivated until further notice.
 Dealing damage with hands is now more accurate.
 Updated animations for almost all weapons and tools.
 Optics of all tools and weapons upgraded.
 Appearance of almost all icons upgraded.
 Character animation system updated.
 Punch animations upgraded.
 Initial preparations made for partnerships.


Fixes

 NPCs now turn back to the correct direction after a dialog.
 Lifting an animal now stops its animation correctly again during the process.
 The Growing book now correctly displays how many days a plant needs to grow out.
 In the Animals book, the food type is now displayed correctly again if the animal uses a specific item as food.

notes.title: You shall not pass
notes.content:
Pathfinding system implemented

The first version of the pathfinding system is now live.
Entities like NPCs, creatures and animals will now always try to avoid obstacles to get to their destination.
No more standing behind a bush or stone and laughing at opponents. Ok, let's say mostly no more.


Improvements

 The tavern in Minestra has been given a more eye-catching tavern sign so that it is easier to recognize as a tavern.
 Catching forest spirits, deer and hares is now a little more difficult.
 Amount of dust required to melt an ingot reduced from 20 to 10.
 Physical behavior of all animals and creatures updated.
 Updated the escape system for creatures and animals.
 Weighting and speed of all creatures and animals standardized.
 Various item icons raised to the new visual standard.
 Run animation of the mushroom heads improved.
 Daily routine of all NPCs slightly adjusted.
 Optimized and updated various systems.


Fixes

 Various minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Market Day & Improvements
notes.content:
New

 Durin the Dwarf now has the new pet Onyx Light Drone in stock.

Market Day Improved

 On market day there is now a wheel of fortune where you can try your luck.
 The Minestra market day now only takes place in spring, summer and fall.
 More visitors now come to the market day to make it more lively.
 Appearance of the Minestra market day enhanced.


Selling prices for most crops increased

 The selling price of most crops is now calculated and depends on their growth time.
While a few plants with a very short growth time have lost a bit of value, the selling price of most plants has increased by about 40 %.


Improvements

 The melting furnace has been replaced with a smaller version that is more suitable for the start of the game.
For the construction, 50 stones and 20 dirt are now required.
 The Beta Portal Ability can no longer be purchased from the Druid.
The Ability will be replaced by another one at a later date.
 Fruit trees and berry bushes now only generate fruit when the appropriate season is active.
Their fruits are now also dropped when they are damaged.
 Light system of all candles, lamps and other light sources in the world updated.
 When packing set structures, a corresponding sound is now also played.
 Placing several structures in a row in build mode now works smoother.
 Notification on activation of new pet upgraded to new system.
 Eastern residential area of Minestra visually upgraded a little.
 Appearance of all cave entrances upgraded.


Fixes

 Orders of decayed plants corrected.
 The fire animation when lighting a campfire should now always be activated reliably.

notes.title: Tutorial, Winter, Decay
notes.content:
Introductory tutorial

 When a new game is created, an introductory tutorial is now automatically started which guides you through the first steps of the game.
Among other things, it explains the way to Minestra, how to interact with the first NPCs, how to craft something and how to use the first ability.


Plant decay is now activated

 Planted plants now die when a season is active in which they cannot live.
When a new season arrives which a particular plant cannot tolerate, this is indicated by an icon above it.
The plant will only die after another day has passed.
A small reminder that the valid seasons can also be found in the book Growing Plants.


New

 Parsnips, Winter Leek and Winter Spinach that can be grown in winter have been added.
Seeds available as usual from the seller Berry.
 Parsnip Soup, Winter Leek Soup, Winter Spinach Soup, Parsnip Salad, Winter Leek Salad, and Winter Spinach Salad added.
All recipes available at the tavern cook after upgrading the tavern.


Improvements

 Striking with the hand is now faster and smoother.
 Various entries in the help menu updated.
 Snowmen visually enhanced.

notes.title: Dresses and Jewelry
notes.content:
New

 Added silk fabric.
 Added Fabric Dress, Blue and Pink Fabric Dress and White Silk Dress.
All recipes available at Tailoring Sandy.
 New diamond deposit, ruby deposit and sapphire deposit added.
Each of these deposits can be found in the cave with the rubble in front of the entrance in the mountains.
In addition, there is always a small chance that these deposits will spawn in the northern mountains.
Gemstones have different effects when used in forging.
Rubies increase the max health. Diamonds the max energy. Sapphire the max mana.
 New craftable rings and necklaces added.
All recipes are available from the blacksmith.
 Added additional equipment slots for a necklace and a 2nd ring.
 Garments in 2 or more parts such as dresses and robes are now also possible.
 In addition to armor and inventory slots, equipment can now also increase the maximum of health, energy and mana.
 The majority of equipment parts now have durability and are no longer stackable in the inventory.
The stats of equipment items that are already in active save states should update themselves by re-equipping them.


Improvements

 All powder colors updated.
 Appearance of iron, silver and gold deposits updated.
 The production of dyed clothing now also always requires a corresponding color powder.
 To make a fabric bag level 4, you now also need some silk fabric.
 Ingredients of the recipes of all level 2 tools updated.
 Sales value of cultivated vegetables increased slightly.
 The Velvet plant is now increasingly to be found in the forest.
 First growing stages of grass and wheat slightly visually enhanced.
 Flying bees that fly around a self-built beehive now move more naturally.
 The book about growing plants now also contains information about the season in which the plant grows.
 Track Day 17 shortened a little and given a more suitable fadeout.
 Crafting time reduced for most recipes.
 And other things.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.519.11 - Onyx_0.1.519.12
notes.content:
New Ability

 Self Heal
Heals your health points by a certain amount.
Available as usual on sundays from the druid in the church.


New

 The Leatherworker now also always has the recipe for the skinning knife on offer.
 Spiders now also drop spider legs.
 New dish spider leg soup added.
Available from the witch in the forest.
 The own inventory now also has a sort button that automatically sorts the content.
Currently in the order Tools -> Weapons -> Equipment -> Seeds -> Other.


Improvements

 Energy costs of all actions such as digging, felling trees, planting seeds, etc. reduced by 20 %.
 When animals are fed, their health is now also fully replenished.
 Stick damage slightly increased.
 Health of several Creatures Reduced.
Shroomheads by 20 %. Pushls by 30 %. Slimes by 40 %.
 Damage of Pushls and Slimes (except the red ones) slightly reduced.
 UI button to transfer the whole inventory optimized.
The items are now moved from the back of the inventory.
So that leftover tools and weapons remain in the quickslots and do not have to be reassigned.
 It is now easier to see which category you are in in the crafting window.
 All old skill icons have been upgraded.
 Various entries in the help menu updated.
 The Conquer ability has been renamed Harmony.
 Casting Harmony now also costs mana if the target is immune or the ability has missed.
 All appearance chances of recipes for potions and dishes at the witch in the forest increased to 25 %.
E.g. Potion of Healing, Potion of Energy, Potion of Armor, Shrinking Potion, etc.
 The kill stats from the character window have been completely removed from the game.
As they have become superfluous due to the introduction of the achievement system.
 The task of decimating spiders can now also appear in the weekly hunter quests.
 The tooltip of abilities now offers more detailed information.
 Range of the spectral grasp ability slightly increased.


Fixes

 The preview in building mode when placing a structure should now load correctly again.
 The first structure should no longer be placed automatically. 
 Animals now behave normally again after they have been picked up and put down. 
 Abilities in the Ability window are no longer duplicated if you have previously closed the window via the UI.
 Fixed some incorrect animation transitions of animals.

notes.title: New Region Spider Forest
notes.content:
New region Spider Forest

 The first version of the Spider Forest has been activated with this update.
 The entrance is located south in the normal forest.


New

 Spider Forest added to the map.
 Tailor Sandy now sells a recipe for making silk yarn from silk fibers.
Currently available with a 50 % chance on the market day.
 The first quest for reputation level 80 is now available from the tailor Sandy.
As a quest reward, she will teach you how to make a level 4 bag.


Improvements

 Charlie in the tavern now directly gives a hint in the first quest that visiting the priest might be beneficial.
 Leyla, the waitress in the tavern, now directly hints at the start that items can already be crafted from the beginning.
 Transparency effects of all trees in unreachable surroundings deactivated to create more vivid transitions.
 The transitions to unreachable terrain are now smoother.
 Various other optimizations.


Fixes

 Achievement notifications with longer titles are now displayed correctly.
 When the character flashes because he was hit, his colors are now reset correctly again.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.519.9
notes.content:
Improvements

 The left mouse button can now be used to place structures when the building system is active, which is much more intuitive than the space bar.
Description of the buttons in the help menu updated accordingly.
 The ingredients of the first melting furnace were changed from 24 cut stones to 24 normal stones.
This is for the time being until further notice to ensure an easier start into the game.
 Lighting in the forest improved.
 Description on the Steam store page spruced up.
 Various other optimizations.


Preparations for the new Spider Forest

 Another new spider type added.
 Added spider cocoons that can contain loot and other stuff.
 Added silk thread as a new resource for tailoring.


Fixes

 The position of carried items and bodies is no longer slightly distorted while running.
 Some less significant bugs fixed.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.519.8
notes.content:
Numpad Shortcuts

 As the 0-9 keys on the Numpad currently have no function, you can now use them to trigger some gestures until further notice.
Also useful if you want to make videos, for example.


Gamemodes

 The Easy game mode has been renamed Cozy and will also be further developed in this direction.


Improvements

 Background music Day014 removed because it was a bit too unpleasant.
 New elements created for a new planned region to be added at a later date.
 Various remaining notifications updated to the new format.


Fixes

 Updated the behavior of the new birds to eliminate the recurring error that occurred during spawning and despawning.
If that doesn't solve the problem, I'll take a hammer to it.

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
Achievements

 First version of an achievement system added.
The corresponding window can be opened via the menu at the bottom left.
For starters, 175 basic Achievements have been added.
Achieving certain Achievements can unlock rewards.
However, as there is no exclusive content for Achievements yet, some Achievements have simply had a little silver added as a reward.
Higher-value and possibly exclusive rewards will be added at a later date.


New for later use

 2 spider types added.
1 of which can also be caught as a pet.
Also matching Achievements already added.


Improvements

 The process of harvesting flowers and mushrooms can now also be canceled by simply pressing the movement keys instead of the space bar.
 Tag Base System updated.


Fixes

 You no longer have to worry about the witch's cat chasing you in the forest.
 An error is no longer triggered if you fill a writable book yourself but only insert very little text.

notes.title: Catchable Pets
notes.content:
New

 Rats added.
 New terrier dog pet added.
 The old shroom pet has been replaced by a new dalmatian dog pet.
 The old green slime pet has been replaced by a new orange fat cat.
 Forest spirits and tiny shrooms now have a small chance of appearing in the forest.


New Ability

 Conquest
Try to gain the weakened target as a pet.
Available from the druid.


New catchable entities

 Pushls, shrooms, tiny shrooms, forest spirits, green slimes, zombies01, zombies02, small ghosts, rats, frogs.
With the increasing number of pets, the pet window will probably have to be upgraded soon.


Improvements

 Shrooms now always drop a hat.
 Shrooms and green slimes can no longer drop an activatable pet of themselves.
 Summoned pets can no longer be lifted until further notice, with the exception of the rock pet.
 All old pet icons updated.
 Information in the pet window reduced to the essentials until further notice.
 Behavior system of all entities updated.
 Some of the core systems completely revised for more stability and future updates.
 When sending a popped-up error message, the active save file is now always sent as well, if possible.
 Help menu.
Pets - Catching Pets.


Fixes

 Use of items during the cast time of spells is now blocked correctly.
 The movement animation of male void slimes is now executed correctly.
 The empty area of the quest favorites area no longer blocks actions that are executed via mouse click.
 Structures placed in the open world, such as explosive barrels, are now correctly discarded when you leave the region.
 Several other bug fixes.

notes.title: A song of caves and keys
notes.content:
New

 Bats added.
 New crafting recipes for iron, silver and gold keys added.
Keys are consumed when you unlock something with them.
All recipes are available from the blacksmith. However, the recipe for the gold key only has a low chance of being offered by him on market day.
 New gates added.
Gates can be opened, for example, by interaction, a lever, a pressure plate or similar.
Some gates may be locked and a suitable key is required to unlock them.
The status of whether a gate or lock is open or closed is currently reset every Monday.
 The path to the Nercromancer in the Crypta is now blocked by a gate that always requires a suitable key to open.
 Added 5 new crate types that can be encountered later.
Wooden crate, Iron crate, Silver crate, Gold crate, Cursed crate.
 Added mana flowers that regenerate mana when eaten.
 The Chest Pet can now be found in a golden crate with a small chance.
 A stronger skeleton in the new cave now has a small chance of dropping the recipe for a silver sword.
 Some new items with a higher retail value have been added, which can be found in more valuable containers.
 A completely new cave tilemap has been added to offer more visual variation.
 The first new cave can now be explored.
The cave in the western mountains with the rocks in front of the entrance has been replaced by the new cave. In addition to loot chests, it also offers more ores as well as an onyx deposit and mana flowers.


Improved

 Loading times of your own piece of land and Minestra improved.
 Further camera movement improvements.
 Various stones and rocks upgraded.
 Help Menu.
Breeding: How to breed bees.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.519.4
notes.content:
Also important

 Happy New Year to you!


Improvements

 Transitions between seasons are now more natural.
 As with digging, the position of the mouse pointer is now always used when planting seeds.
 Dialog entries that contain quests are now color-coded to make them easier to recognize.
General quests and time-dependent quests such as weeklies are marked differently.
 Help Menu improved.
Crafting: How to craft items. Breeding: Buying and feeding animals.
 Initial preparation for new caves implemented.
 New camera movement features added in preparation for the upcoming content.
 Text wording in the window when an error occurs optimized.
To make it clearer that in most cases you can simply close the window and continue playing, as it won’t have any truly problematic impact on the gameplay.


Fixes

 The correct energy icon is now displayed in the tooltip of edible items.
 Weekly quests should now always display the correct times and run more stable.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the color of the blink effect to not reset correctly when you were hit.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.519.2
notes.content:
Improvements

 The texts of various notifications have been improved.
 A background image with hints is now also displayed at the transition from the coast to your own piece of land.


Fixes

 This one tree in the forest no longer suffers from a black hole.
 Various graphic errors at different transitions between ground and cliffs fixed.
 Fixed a bug that caused the character to freeze when fishing in a waterhole where there is nothing to catch.
 Randomly appearing bee and bird nests on trees are now displayed correctly in front of the new tree trunks.
 The current day marker in the calendar now also takes the current season into account and should therefore always be displayed correctly.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.519.1
notes.content:
Seasons

 Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter are activated with this update.
Seasons do not have to be taken into account when growing plants for the time being, so that you still have full access to all options in the current phase.
A new game always starts in the summer season.


New

 White snow hares added.


Improvements

 An icon on the UI clock now shows active events.
The tooltip also shows how long the event will last.
 If you wish, you can now release mounts by using the hammer on them.
Yes, the hammer.
 Certain animals now only appear in appropriate seasons.
 UI upgraded in many places.


Also important

 Wishing you a joyful holiday season!

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.45
notes.content:
Steam

 Request submitted to Steam for publication.


Improvements

 The resource required to obtain onyx from the dwarves via the weekly quest has been greatly reduced.
 Ability “Force” deactivated until its next update.
 Updated descriptions of various items.
 Lots of UI improvements.


Fixes

 Event-dependent spawns should now always appear and disappear at the correct times of day.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.44
notes.content:
Onyx Gameplay Trailer

 The first prototype of a gameplay trailer is now live on the Steam page.
So you can get a better insight into how the game feels.


New

 The first heavy armor including helmet can now be crafted.
 Jacob and his blacksmithing apprenticeship expanded.
Quest line expanded. You can now go through the process of making iron tools, a weapon and all armor parts, for which you always receive corresponding recipes.
In addition, you will now also receive the recipe for iron arrows for the expansion of Jacob's house.


Reputation system simplified
As it sometimes led to confusion.

 Gifts to NPCs can now only be made once a day.
Regardless of whether it had a positive, neutral or negative effect.


Improvements

 Entries in the reputation window can now be favorited.
 On market day, there is now always a small chance that valuable loot will be dropped when smashing the pinata.
 When an empty quickslot is selected, it is now better indicated that the free hands are in use.
 Some of the UI elements are now more recognizable.
 The immortality buff no longer replenishes health.
 Despawn speeds of all objects are now individual.
 Entering beds is now more comfortable.
 Tooltips upgraded in many ways.
 Fishing is now more rewarding.
 Leaves can now also be eaten.
At the request of a tester. I don't know why you should do that, but have fun with it!


Fixes

 Fixed a bug that prevented stores from being updated correctly when purchasing a breeding animal.
 The color for currently craftable recipes in the crafting window is now set correctly.
 A large number of other bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.43
notes.content:
New

 Sparrows have been added.
 Crows have been added.


Minestra market day

 A pinata now hangs on the tree in front of the tavern.
Assuming the tree is still standing at the time.


Improvements

 Equipment system upgraded.
 Hair is now faded to different levels depending on what headgear you are wearing.
This means that helmets, for example, can now also be added to the game.
 Riding no longer costs energy.
 Donkeys now also make a galloping sound.
 Added new system for interacting with the environment.
For example, if you have found footprints and click on them, your character could give you a hint.
 Instant quests can now be accepted and completed with one interaction.
 Help menu expanded to include more information on the reputation system.
 The fruits of trees and bushes now fall more realistically when you interact with them.
 Scrolling in the inventory has been replaced by automatic window adjustment to the available slots.
 Initial preparations made to implement seasons at a later date.
 Felling trees now feels a little more realistic.
 Various character animations upgraded.
 Various sound effects upgraded.


Fixes

 Arrows no longer inflict damage if they are just lying around and entities run into them.
 Closing the game menu while sitting on a mount no longer freezes the mount temporarily.
 The button to copy the current error message to the clipboard now works again as usual.
 Birds no longer try to annoy the character by bumping into them.
 Felled trees are now reliably loaded again in their felled state.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.42
notes.content:
New Abilities

 Plant Sling V1
Summons a wild creeper.
 Force V1 (Prototype)
Push back all opponents around you.
Can also be used to trigger crop plants, for example.


Improvements

 Relevant regeneration values are now automatically displayed above the player.
The display can also be deactivated in the settings.
 The player now also flashes briefly when he takes damage.
 Legitimate targets for physical projectiles set to actual entities until further notice.
Arrows no longer get stuck on terrain. Enemies no longer shoot their friends in the back. Stuff like that.
 Extended character stats now show, for example, what you have already knocked down in the entire game time.
Can be viewed via the character window.
 Savegames are now sorted in the main menu according to the last time they were accessed.
 Various new UI functions have been added to simplify inventory tasks.
 The Necromancer's room has been made a little more interesting.
 Removing savegames via the main menu is now quicker.
 Start sounds volume adjusted for new games.
 Various background music tracks adapted.
 New sounds and sound effects added.
 Various UI graphics upgraded.


Fixes

 Placing structures should now work as usual again.
 Various animation errors fixed.
 Many others.
Some of the bugs were obviously immune to fire.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.41
notes.content:
UI Themes

 The first UI theme can now be activated in the game.
Some of the UI windows will be decorated a little.
When starting a new game, the first UI theme is pre-activated.
UI themes can be changed or deactivated in the settings.


New Abilities

 Rock V1
Manifests a rock at the destination.
 Aligned V1
You're aligned. Your abilities cost no mana.


Improvements

 Ability slots increased to 6.
 The Tree God now grants the Aligned buff instead of the mana regeneration buff, which reduces all mana costs to 0 and lasts for 20 real-life minutes in the current version.
With a bit of planning, you can cause quite a bit of mischief with this.
 The ManaToEnergy and ManaToHealth buffs have been deactivated until further notice.
 Zombie invasions are now a little more apocalyptic again.
The selected game mode now has more influence on activated zombie invasions.
 The character now eats when you consume edible items.
 All spawn and despawn effects are now smoother.
 Optimized audio settings for new game starts.
 Appearance of many ui elements enhanced.
 More magic effects added.


Fixes

 Various graphic errors fixed.
 2 kg of bugs scared away.
Next time I'd better try fire straight away.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.40
notes.content:
Steam Page

 Added some new screenshots and updated some older ones.


New

 The Forest Witch now also offers the recipe for a Speed Buff potion.


Start Menu upgraded

 The start menu is now also adapted for 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9 aspect ratios.
 If you want to create a new game, the character now starts with randomly selected parts.
 Added a randomize button, just because it's fun.
 The character now behaves more vividly in the preview.
 The mini-game in the start menu now runs more conveniently.


Improvements

 Ability equip cooldown reduced to 5 seconds.
 With the "Revive Zombie as Companion" ability, you can now explicitly select a corpse to be resurrected with the mouse.
A random corpse in a radius is no longer selected.
 Animals that have been put on a leash now run as long as they follow the player.
Smaller, slower animals can still simply be lifted and carried.
 Knockback effect of all weapons and abilities used on enemies reactivated. The effect now also runs much more smoothly.
Knockback effects of opponents on the player left deactivated for now.
 If an error occurs in the game, the error message can now simply be copied to the clipboard via a button.
Thank you for your support and feedback so far!
 Various spells now have their own animation and magic sound effect.
 Buffs of the same type now overwrite each other when applied.
 Climbing onto a mount is now more convenient.


Fixes

 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the wrong body to be assigned.
 Wild animals and wild creatures should now only appear and disappear at their scheduled times.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.39
notes.content:
Character creation extended

 Customizing your character to your own needs is a very important point.
Therefore, it is now possible to customize all available parts such as face, body, body color, hairstyle, hair color, beard and beard color.
In addition, there are no restrictions on the choice of different parts.
So if, for example, you want a female body with a female face, an black beard and white hair sticking up, nothing stands in the way.


New

 For helping Marek expand his house, you now also receive the recipe for the leather apron (shirt and pants) that the blacksmith also wears.
But don't tell the blacksmith, he thinks he's wearing exclusive clothes.


New Abilities
All of them are available from the druid until further notice.

 Spectral Grasp
Reach through the spectral fog and try to pull an object towards you.
 Fireball
Unleashes a fireball in a chosen direction.
 Plant Growth
Stimulates the growth of a selected plant and increases its growth level by 1, if possible.
Note, the previously added spell that stimulates the growth of all plants in a radius has been renamed “Plants Growth V1”.


Improvements

 The ability to revive a zombie as a companion now drops with a small chance from the Necromancer in the Crypta and is no longer simply available from the Druid.
 Accessibility to recipes of various houses deactivated.
They will return to the game later with a new style.
 The smelting furnace has also been standardized and now works completely via the associated inventory.
Simply place flammable items and items to be melted in it, activate the furnace and it will do the rest.
 Various houses visually upgraded.


Fixes

 Day song #3 now has a proper fade out effect and is no longer ended abruptly.
 Zombies revived as companions no longer sometimes turn into mini zombies that get completely out of control.
Even though it was actually quite funny to watch.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.38
notes.content:
New

 The tree god now gives a weekly quest where you can supply him with essences to get a one-time mana reg buff.
 Berry now also has the first reputation quest where you receive the recipe for an irrigation propeller as a reward.
 Helping Berry expand her house now gives the Plant Growth V1 Ability as a reward.


New Abilities

 Plant Growth
Stimulates plant growth in the surrounding area and increases the grow levels by 1.


Random portal converted into beta portal

 Opens a portal to a randomly generated region where you can encounter new flora and fauna, for example, which are currently still in the test phase and may be found in the world of Hyalen at a later date.

Improvements

 Quests that grant a one-time buff are now also displayed accordingly in the quest log under Rewards.
 The miniboss in the Crypta now behaves more like a Necromancer and has become a little more dangerous.
 The reputation window now displays a hint when an NPC offers an unfinished reputation quest that can be unlocked by increasing their reputation.
So that you don't get annoyed if you increase the reputation of an NPC but get nothing in return.
Some NPCs already offer a quest that is unlocked with a value of 30.
 UI and regions adapted for 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9 aspect ratios.
 The proportions within UI avatars should now be better displayed.
 All Abilities are now displayed more clearly in the Ability window.
 The tooltip of active buffs now shows the remaining duration.
 Grow systems prepared to bring fertilizer into play later.
 Irrigation radius of summoned rain clouds increased.
 Butterflies can no longer be caught by hand.


Fixes

 The 2nd growth stage of lettuce is now the correct size.

notes.title: Onyx_0.1.518.37
notes.content:
New

 Gordon is now giving out a quest that could provide a clue to your past.
 The first miniboss can now be found in the last room of the Crypta.
 The renegade bandit now sells various hats when you meet him in his hideout.
Sunhat, Fruithat, Beehat, Pighat, asm.
 A campfire can now be made again. The recipe for this is added automatically.
 Fireplaces such as campfires or smelting furnaces now have a heat zone around them.
 Certain eggs can now be hatched in heat zones.
 It is now possible to obtain void slime eggs by releasing excavated old relics.
To breed void slimes, a male and a female are required and it is not known which sex will hatch from an egg. You must also ensure that the right food is available, which can only be grown by yourself and cannot simply be found in the world. The mating of void slimes does not produce a child, but always a void slime egg, which can be hatched in a heat zone.
Long story short: To breed void slimes, several eggs and at least 1 seed of void berries should be available.

Improvements

 Various UI windows slightly reduced in size.
 Quickbar slots increased to 14.

Fixes

 Killing an enemy while his projectile is still flying no longer triggers an error.
